title: PILLAGERS DRAWN A THIRD THE SIZE
why: His note of 2026-10-25, played on the old build 33.17, where the figure was drawn at 1.25: player character is still wayyy too big, needs to be 1/3 of the size he is right now. So every human figure (both players, the pillager bots, hires, the survivor, the peddler, downed and falling bodies, the Undercroft crowd) is drawn at a third of what he saw: FIG_SCALE 1.25/3, about 0.42 of the size 1 art (34.83 drew 0.8), drawing only: hit areas, walking, doors and the nav grid keep their old radius. FIG_UP now follows FIG_SCALE, so every plate and tag keeps the gap over the head it had on the size 1 figure. Things placed for the full size body follow it: the side mark, the world muzzle flash with the tracer start and the brass, the forge glow, the DEMO spawn shield, the power shield bubble, the waterline, the HUD plates over your head (cook, reload, seal, forge), the get-up bar (now just over the head of a bot rising in a crouch, under his nameplate), the peddler pack frame, the fall shadow and the ascent sink. The golden body pass draws the golden pillager on its own canvas, where figOn() was false, so he was drawn at size 1 (2.4 times the others with this change); figOn() now knows that pass, and the golden and the outlined elite body (rimOpen) send their ground shadow back to the world canvas with the transform the body is drawn with, so they stand on a shadow of their own size. The forge element effects on a pillager, the survivor and the peddler (flames, shock, the ice block, the chill ring, acid) were fitted to the 0.8 body (elemBodyH 34, the hit radius for the width): they follow the drawn body now (elemBodyK, FIG_SCALE/0.8), and machines and the pixel look keep theirs. The HUD plates over your head take the head part of their lift in world units times ZOOM and the gap in HUD px times hudRes (figHudLift, the way the bot plates already lift), so they sit just over the drawn head at 1080, at 4K, zoomed in and aimed; measured at 4K on 34.85, the reload bar was drawn across the head. The P1 and P2 seat ring and the red downed ring keep their full size so they still read. In the pixel look (its own size, PIX_FIGK) the plates keep the lift they had (figUpL, FIG_UP 4 there) and the aim dots no longer take FIG_SCALE, so they start at the pixel gun. The world muzzle flash sprite was fitted to the 0.8 body (about 0.7 of the gun) and was drawn about 20 units long on a rifle about 15 long, a plume longer than the gun: the flash of a player or a pillager, in his window and in the partner window, is sized to the smaller gun now (FIG_SCALE/0.8; a machine and the pixel look keep theirs). Tracers were drawn 12 units up for every round, 3 over the barrel of the smaller body: a round from a drawn gun carries the height of its gun line (20 times the drawn size), in both windows. The survivor draws no gun and fires a pistol when turned: his flash kept the old size (about 20 long next to a body about 19 tall) at 12 up, over his hands, so his flash takes the same size as a pillager flash, and his flash and tracer sit at the gun line of his drawn body (shotLy), and his word to the partner window now carries his flash point, so both windows draw it the same. His order of 2026-10-20 says the figure should be scaled properly compared to bodies on ground: a dead pillager, the survivor and your own body were drawn from the size 1 art, about 40 long next to a pillager now about 19 tall, so they are drawn at the figure scale on the world canvas, on a shadow of their size (the deer carcass, the wrecks and the pixel bake keep theirs). The side mark sat at one spot left of the head, so on a bot aiming left it covered his gun and flash (51 in 100 of his gun pixels on the last draft; 26 in 100 on 34.89 aiming down left): it sits beside the head on the side away from his aim now, flipping on the rule the body mirrors on, and covers none of his gun in eight aims, for a hostile bot and a hire. The smoke, decoy and trip cook plates have a second row (LH(11), 17 HUD px at 1080) and ended on the smaller head: they lift by that row and end the same gap over the head as the frag plate (16.3 HUD px at every screen and zoom; a fixed 41 left them 10.3 over). The glow round the survivor was fitted to the 0.8 body (centred 14 up, 40 round) and sat on the head of the smaller one: it follows his drawn body (FIG_SCALE/0.8). The give prompt over the survivor sat at a fixed 40 screen px over his feet, on his head at 4K (on 34.89 it covered 44 of his 72 px): it lifts as the seal and forge prompts over a head (figHudLift(66)), so 1080 at ZOOM 1 is where it was and 4K and aimed in keep the gap.
now: Every pillager, bot, hire and body is drawn at a third of the size you saw on the old copy (build 33.17), about half of the size on the newest build (drawing only: hit areas, walking and doors keep their old size). Name plates, party tags, the shields, the muzzle flash and the tracers, the golden pillager, the fire and ice of forged guns, the survivor glow and the bodies on the ground follow the smaller body; the side mark beside a bot sits on the side away from his gun; the reload bar, the grenade timer and the give prompt sit just over the head on the 4K screen and when aiming too (on the newest build the reload bar was drawn across his head at 4K); the P1 and P2 seat rings and the red downed ring keep their full size so they still read. Watch for: the small body being hard to spot in a fight or on the big screen, the smaller muzzle flash being easy to miss on the TV, shots that look like misses still hitting (the hit circle is now much bigger than the body), the crowbar reaching further than its swing looks, with superhot holding time a shot that has not moved yet drawing its tracer over the front half of the gun, the smaller survivor glow being easy to miss, the round hatch you ascend from looking big under you, the Undercroft crowd looking small next to the stations, and the deer and the trees looking big next to him.
